name: Simkl Scrobbler
description: Scrobble your watched Movies, TV Shows and Anime to Simkl in real time. Reports start, pause and stop as you watch, shows the title in your Simkl 'Watching now' banner, and marks items watched automatically once you stop past 80%.

versions.changelog: Manual check marks now sync to Simkl: ticking an episode, a season or a movie as played adds it to your history (batched per season), and optionally unticking removes it (off by default). The settings page now shows your Simkl watch statistics and the last scrobble result. Every API request now identifies the app to Simkl (app-name/app-version), as required since April 2026.

New independent plugin identity (own plugin id, updates only through this repository). Includes the 9.0.0.4 fix: the series' own IMDB/TMDB/TVDB ids are sent when scrobbling an episode, so shows whose episodes carry their own IMDB ids (e.g. Euphoria US) are tracked correctly without the filename fallback.

name: Simkl (moved to Simkl Scrobbler)
description: THIS PLUGIN HAS MOVED: install 'Simkl Scrobbler' from the same repository to keep receiving updates, then uninstall this one. Your Simkl login and settings are kept. Scrobbling keeps working in the meantime.
overview: This plugin has moved to Simkl Scrobbler

versions.changelog: FINAL release under this plugin id — the plugin continues as 'Simkl Scrobbler' (new plugin id) in this same repository. After updating, install 'Simkl Scrobbler' from the catalog, then uninstall this one; your Simkl login and settings are kept. This release still scrobbles normally (9.0.0.4 series-ids fix included) and goes dormant automatically once Simkl Scrobbler is installed.
